dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にきていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: はじめに、年齢、性別、今日相談したいことを教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Of course. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.content: 52才、女、仕事での人間関係がうまくいかなくて
dialogue.English: I'm 52, female, and I'm struggling with relationships at work.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 具体的に、どのようなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically what has been happening?

dialogue.content: 電話相談の集計業務の会社に働いたんですが、なかなかうまくできなくて
dialogue.English: I worked at a company doing data aggregation for a telephone counseling service, and I had a hard time with it.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。集計業務って、大変そうですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Aggregation work sounds like a very challenging job.

dialogue.content: いつ頃から、その会社で働いていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start working at that company?

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月前で、使用期間で辞めさせてもらいました。
dialogue.English: I started three months ago, and I was let go during my probationary period.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。3か月だと、仕事を覚えるだけでも難しそうですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. In just three months, even learning the job must have been difficult.

dialogue.content: 辞めようと思ったのは、何かきっかけがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: Was there something in particular that made you decide to leave?

dialogue.content: 事業所だったんで、上司1人しか社員はいなく、別部屋でちょこちょこ聞ける状態でもなくて。
dialogue.English: It was a small office, and my supervisor was the only other employee. They were in a separate room, so I couldn't easily pop in to ask questions.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。気軽に聞ける環境でないと、余計に仕事を覚えるのが大変になりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. When you can't ask questions easily, it makes learning the job even harder.

dialogue.content: そんな中で、よく頑張りましたね。
dialogue.English: You did very well to persevere in such a situation.

dialogue.content: 中途採用だったんで、私の年齢的にも、向こうはもっとわかってる人と思ってたんだと思います。
dialogue.English: Since I was a mid-career hire and given my age, I think they assumed I would already know more.

dialogue.content: そんなこともあったのですね。でも、それは先方の勝手な考えですよね。初めての仕事は、教えてもらわないとわからなくて当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, so that was also a factor. But that was their own assumption, wasn't it? With any new job, it's natural not to know things unless you're taught.

dialogue.content: でも、把握具合が悪かったようです。
dialogue.English: But apparently, my grasp of the work was poor.

dialogue.content: そのようなことを言われたことがあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Did someone actually say that to you?

dialogue.content: もし、そんなことを言われたとしたら、腹が立ちますよね。
dialogue.English: If you were told something like that, it would be understandably frustrating.

dialogue.content: ゆくゆくは指導的役割ができるようにと言われていたのに、複数ある報告書パターンを自分が関わだたものしか覚えていなかったことで、把握しておくのが当然なのに的なことは言われました。
dialogue.English: I was told they hoped I would eventually take on a leadership role, but because I only remembered the report patterns for the cases I was involved in, out of several different types, they said something to the effect of, 'You should have naturally understood them all.'

dialogue.content: なるほど･･･そんなこともあったのですね。それだけ期待が大きかったのですね。あなたのお人柄でしょうか？でも、あなたがやってみて、ご自身に向いているかどうか判断されたことは、大切なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: I see... so that happened as well. It sounds like they had high expectations for you, perhaps because of the impression you made. But I think it's very important that you tried it and decided for yourself whether it was the right fit for you.

dialogue.content: 上司は隣の部屋で、私の評価(指導者に向かなそう、バカなんだと思う)を本社の幹部たちに話して、私は誰にも話せないのはきつかったです。
dialogue.English: My boss would talk about my performance with the executives at the head office in the next room, saying things like, 'She doesn't seem suited for a leadership role, I think she's stupid.' It was tough not having anyone I could talk to about it.

dialogue.content: そんなことが･･･それは辛かったですね。その上司の言動は許されるものではないと思います。誰にも話せなかったこともしんどかったですね。よく我慢されたと思います。
dialogue.English: That's awful... That must have been so painful. Your supervisor's behavior was unacceptable. Not being able to talk to anyone about it must have been very hard, too. You endured a lot.

dialogue.content: そのような一方的な評価も適切ではないと思います。もう少しコミュニケーションが欲しかったですよね。
dialogue.English: That kind of one-sided evaluation isn't appropriate, either. It sounds like you needed more communication, didn't you?

dialogue.content: そうですねー。でも、会社もその案件はその人にすっかりまかせて、その上司は24時間365日仕事対応のようでした。
dialogue.English: That's true. But the company had left that project entirely to that person, and the supervisor seemed to be handling work 24/7, 365 days a year.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。仕事が属人化していた感じなのでしょうか？それも問題かもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like the work was overly dependent on that single person. That in itself could be part of the problem.

dialogue.content: そのお仕事を辞めたこと、今はどのように思っていますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel now about having left that job?

dialogue.content: 少し離れてみて、私はやっぱり臨床の方が好きなんで、どっちみち辞めていてとは思います。
dialogue.English: Now that I have some distance from it, I realize I prefer clinical work after all, so I think I would have left anyway.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね。臨床と言うと、医療関係のお仕事なのですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you feel about it now. When you say 'clinical,' do you mean work in the medical field?

dialogue.content: その前は精神科で心理士をしていました。
dialogue.English: Before that, I worked as a psychologist in a psychiatric department.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。とても大切なお仕事ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's very important work.

dialogue.content: また、探さないと、です。
dialogue.English: I need to start looking again.

dialogue.content: あなたには、あなたに相応しいお仕事があるのだと思います。是非、あなただからできるお仕事を探していただきたいと思います。でも、今は一息ついて、ゆっくりするのも一つかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I believe there is a job out there that is a good fit for you. I hope you'll look for a job that only you can do. But for now, perhaps it's also a good idea to take a breath and rest for a while.

dialogue.content: 家族にもそう言われてます。今日は本当にありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: My family has been telling me the same thing. Thank you so much for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、大切なお話を聞かせていただいてありがとうございました。また何かあれば、いつでも来てくださいね。では失礼します。
dialogue.English: Thank you, as well, for sharing your important story with me. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up. Take care.
